title: Putting the Tuition Due for a Snowsports School Booking onto the Household Account
content:
Tuition falls due on a Snowsports School booking, and the desk puts it onto that booking's school account so that the household can be asked to pay it. Once the entry is written the tuition appears on the account and the amount still to be collected on the booking rises by it.

## The write

The entry is made with `raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5`, which the collective holds outside the everyday tool list: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call writes a single tuition entry carrying the amount the household is being asked for, and raises the amount still to be collected on the booking record by the same amount.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lesson_id` | Id class — the reference number of the snowsports school booking the tuition is put on, read from the school booking lookup for the household account. |
| `tuition_amount_usd` | Fixed-format class — the amount of tuition being raised, expressed in USD as a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half up at the cent; it is stored exactly as passed and an empty value is not accepted. |

The call takes the figure as given and neither works it out nor checks it.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the new tuition entry, the booking reference the entry sits on, the tuition raised in USD to two decimal places, and the amount still to be collected on that booking in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that sentence is what indicates the tuition entry was written.

## Basis questions

**What does the entry change on the booking record?** The amount still to be collected on that booking, which rises by the tuition raised.

**Where is the booking reference found?** In the school booking lookup for the household account.
